title: The All in One SEO – AI SEO Plugin to Boost SEO Rankings & Traffic (Schema, Local SEO, Sitemap & SEO Insights) plugin…
description: The All in One SEO – AI SEO Plugin for WordPress versions up to 5.0.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'name' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view affected pages. Exploitation requires specific conditions including WordPress 6.6 or later with the Interactivity runtime and an administrator placing the AIOSEO breadcrumb on the author template.
